description: This file defines a routing system for handling HTTP requests, including classes for tokenizing route patterns, compiling them into regex, and matching requests to handlers.

classes.name: RouteTokenizer
classes.description: Tokenizes route pattern strings into components like literals, slashes, groups, and stars.

classes.name: RouteCompiler
classes.description: Compiles tokenized route patterns into regex objects for matching.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: Manages route registration and request handling by matching request paths to registered handlers.

methods.name: literal
methods.description: Returns a token for a literal string component.

methods.name: slash
methods.description: Returns a token for a slash component.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Returns a token for a group component, capturing a named segment.

methods.name: star
methods.description: Returns a token for a star component, matching any remaining path.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Tokenizes an input route pattern string into components.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles a list of tokens into a regex pattern.

methods.name: process_literal
methods.description: Escapes a literal token for regex.

methods.name: process_slash
methods.description: Returns a slash character for regex.

methods.name: process_group
methods.description: Creates a regex group for a named path segment.

methods.name: process_star
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern for matching remaining path segments.

methods.name: compile_path_match
methods.description: Tokenizes and compiles a route pattern into a regex object.

methods.name: Router
methods.description: Handles route registration and request matching based on method and path pattern.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a route with methods, path pattern, and handler.

methods.name: get_handler
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate handler for a given request based on method and path.
